text:
If you like your air on the crisp side, today's your day: sunny, comfortable humidity, and a high near 76 that won't ask anything of you. There's a special weather statement out this morning, likely tied to that patchy dense fog some spots saw at sunrise, but by the time you're out and about it should be burned off and irrelevant. The lake's in good shape too, water's a swimmable 75, with north winds 5 to 15 knots keeping a light chop, 1 to 2 feet, nothing that should keep paddlers off the water. Winds go light overnight under partly cloudy skies, low near 55.

Sunday holds dry and mild through the day, high near 82, before the story changes after dark. Forecasters are increasingly confident a soaking rain moves in Sunday night into Monday morning, with a real chance of an inch or more, and the lake will feel it too, winds building to 15 to 25 knots and better than a foot of chop by evening. Enjoy today and Sunday daytime fully; if you're on the water Sunday, plan to be off by early evening.

week.blurb: Sunny and comfortably dry with a high near 76, about as good as August gets.
Mostly sunny and warm near 82, but showers and thunderstorms roll in after dark.
Showers likely in the morning before things try to dry out, high near 80.
Sunny and pleasant again, high near 82, no rain to plan around.
Mostly sunny through the afternoon, high near 84, then showers build in after 2pm.
Rain showers likely much of the day, high near 79, keep the umbrella handy.
Mostly sunny and dry to close the week, high near 78.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST: BURLINGTON, Vt. (WCAX) - Some parts of the region are getting patchy dense fog this morning, especially through the Adirondacks and Green Mountains. Use caution if you’re traveling. The rest of today will be a beautiful day with mostly sunny skies and highs in the 70s. The humidity will be in the comfortable range. Expect another cool night Saturday night with the colder valleys back in the 40s. Sunday itself will be dry with partly sunny skies. Highs will be back in the 70s. Showers will move in Sunday night.
